subject: Web Development
title: The Disability Spectrum
description: A 60-second lesson on The Disability Spectrum.

hook.text: Disability isn't binary. It exists on a spectrum that shifts throughout everyone's life.

buildup.text: Permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities all affect how people use the web.

discovery.text: A broken arm, a bright room, or holding a baby — these all create temporary access barriers.

twist.text: Almost everyone experiences some form of access barrier every single day without realizing it.

climax.text: Thinking of disability as a spectrum makes accessibility feel personal, not abstract.

punchline.text: Accessibility is personal — everyone needs it.
